{{Top|leg}}
'''Criticality lights''' were used to diagnose the state of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] repair. They indicated a droid could direct its own actions. At least to the young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the lights positively indicated that a droid was fully repaired.<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
